root_idea.summary: The root centers on determining a thing's measure and proportion, and on smoothness or evenness.
root_idea.development: From measuring and proportioning, the lexicon develops into forming or bringing something into existence, whether by originating it or producing it from an existing substance. It also extends to outward constitution, inner disposition, allotted share, fabrication, smoothness, and wearing out.

senses.definition: To measure, proportion, design, and form something according to a determined measure or pattern.
senses.usage_conditions: This includes making a form from a material according to its proper proportions, as in the forming of a thing like a bird from clay. It can describe either the determining of the design or its execution.

senses.definition: To bring into existence, create, or produce a thing.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses this for originating beings and worlds, and for producing one thing from another. With God as subject it denotes creative origination and bringing into being according to wise determination; it is not restricted to creation from no preexisting material in every passage.

senses.definition: To fabricate or forge speech, a claim, falsehood, or other fiction.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a figurative use for devising a false saying or falsehood, including the construction of creating falsehood.

senses.definition: In a Quranic euphemistic construction, to refer to the sexual organs or sexual relations made available for intercourse.
senses.usage_conditions: This specialized construction occurs in the expression concerning what the Lord has created for them; the lexical explanation identifies it as a reference to women's sexual organs and the sexual practice being condemned in the verse.

senses.definition: Formed, fully formed, or having its bodily features become apparent.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic embryological construction it contrasts with an unformed lump and indicates a stage whose form is established or discernible.

senses.definition: One who creates, originates, or brings things into existence; the Creator.
senses.usage_conditions: With the definite article as a divine epithet, it denotes the Creator. As an indefinite active participle it can describe an agent who is about to create or who creates in a particular act.

senses.definition: One who determines, proportionates, or forms things according to their proper measure.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense is especially relevant in comparative or plural expressions such as “the best of the formers or proportioners,” while the same participle can elsewhere mean Creator in the stronger sense.

senses.definition: A share or portion, especially an allotted share of good, righteousness, or religious merit.
senses.usage_conditions: The word may denote an ordinary portion, but Quranic contexts emphasize the portion of good or the reward allotted to a person.

senses.definition: Creation: the act, result, or ordered reality of bringing things into existence.
senses.usage_conditions: The word can refer to creation as an activity or to the created order. In expressions such as “the creation of God,” classical interpretation may focus on created nature, divine ordinance, or religion, depending on the construction; these are interpretive applications of the same created-order sense.

senses.definition: Created beings or created things; the creation collectively.
senses.usage_conditions: It may denote beings generally, or specifically mankind, jinn, or other classes of creatures when the context supplies that scope.

senses.definition: The outward make, form, stature, or visible constitution of a created thing.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense concerns the features and proportions apprehended outwardly, including a person's or creature's bodily make and the form of a thing.

senses.definition: The great, supreme, or prolific Creator; one who creates abundantly.
senses.usage_conditions: The intensive form emphasizes greatness, abundance, or repeated creative activity rather than introducing a different act from ordinary creating.

senses.definition: A custom, habitual practice, or established way of conduct.
senses.usage_conditions: It can denote a practice inherited from earlier people, as in the Quranic expression describing the custom of the ancients.

senses.definition: Inner moral character, disposition, or religious conduct.
senses.usage_conditions: This concerns the inward qualities and habits by which a person is formed and acts; “religion” can be an extended contextual rendering when those qualities are expressed through disciplined conduct.
The noun denotes a claim or statement deliberately made up rather than true; in the Quran it occurs as an accusation of fabrication.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something smooth, even, or equable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an arrow, wood, a stick, or another object that has been smoothed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become goodly, complete, or well made in bodily constitution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence illustrates the verb with bodily make; the definition is stated neutrally and is not restricted to a particular gender.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become smooth, even, or free from irregularity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may be applied to a thing such as a rock, including one free from cracks or fractures.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become old and worn out; of a garment, to become threadbare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same branch is extended figuratively to declining youth or a face worn by degrading use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be naturally adapted, disposed, suitable, or worthy for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction takes a complement expressing the act or quality for which someone or something is considered fitted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rub or perfume someone with khulūq, a traditional perfume.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may be transitive, including perfuming another person or applying the perfume to the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To associate or comport oneself with people according to their natures or moral qualities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction can mean dealing with someone according to their character, or dealing with them with good character.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wear something out, or to have or become provided with old and worn clothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may be transitive or intransitive and is also used figuratively of time wearing something out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clothe someone in an old garment or give someone an old garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the person receiving or being clad in the worn garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cutting out of a garment after it has been measured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized clothing expression associated with the sequence of wearing out or replacing a garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be likely, probable, or expected to be the case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The impersonal and comparative expressions in this branch concern probability or what is likely to happen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect or feign a nature, character, or quality that is not one's own.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes pretending before people or assuming a disposition contrary to one's real intention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rub oneself with or become perfumed by khulūq.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the reflexive or intransitive perfume construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become very smooth, even, or uniform; of clouds, to gather and become prepared or likely to rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intensive form is used of a horse's back, a trace becoming level with the ground, and clouds whose sides gather or become ready to rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything made smooth or even.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the nominal result associated with smoothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Old, worn-out, or threadbare; also an old or decayed thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The epithet can describe garments, ropes, houses, bodies, and similar things, and appears in idioms involving the cheapness of worn goods.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloud bearing a sign of rain or giving hope of rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can describe a cloud whose condition indicates or promises rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The prescribed midday sleep or nap.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an established phrase rather than a general additional sense of moral character.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smoothness or evenness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is a nominal expression for the quality of being smooth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular natural make or constitution, especially the constitution of an animated being.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can also describe something natural or original, as opposed to an acquired or accidental condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Natural, constitutional, or belonging to an innate constitution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It contrasts with what is chosen, acquired, or accidental, and may describe a natural fault or quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who wears old and worn-out clothes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a lexicalized adjective or substantivized description of habitual clothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of old and worn-out clothes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is occupational and derives from the branch concerning worn garments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A yellowish perfume composed chiefly of saffron and other ingredients.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is described as a fluid or thick perfume traditionally associated especially with women's use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Perfect, complete, or well proportioned in make.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe a bodily constitution or a formed object whose proper proportions have become apparent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adapted, suited, fit, worthy, or disposed to do or receive something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Common constructions use لِـ, بِـ, or أَنْ with the action or quality for which the subject is considered suitable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Probable or likely to happen or be the case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the probability use of the adjective, distinct from being inherently suited or worthy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Habituated or accustomed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense describes a disposition established through repeated association or practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Like or resembling another person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may express likeness or correspondence rather than aptitude.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beasts, brutes, or nonhuman creatures.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This collective use occurs in an expression contrasting mankind with animals or other creatures.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A newly dug well, a waterless well, or a natural hollow or cavity in the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term covers several closely related kinds of excavated or hollow places, including a small mountain cavity in which water stagnates.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large smooth masses of stone at the head of a well, used as standing places by the person drawing water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized plural or collective term for the stones of a watering place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A worker in leather or a similar material who measures and cuts it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This occupational noun reflects the sequence of determining a measure and then cutting the material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smooth mountains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is attested as a plural whose singular is not specified in the cited passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smooth, solid, and resistant to impression; free from cracks or fractures.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can describe stone, rock, a camel's foot, or a barren hill, with the precise object supplied by context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Poor or destitute, especially lacking property or good deeds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative extension from being bare or smooth of what ordinarily covers or marks it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The exterior of a horse's hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Impervious to sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited adjective is applied to a woman in this specialized anatomical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sky, conceived as smooth and even.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a substantivized use based on the sky's perceived smoothness or evenness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The outer side or flank of a camel or similar animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can identify the smooth outer part of the animal's side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interior, visible, and smooth part of the upper mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This anatomical term refers to the upper interior of the mouth and its exposed smooth surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The even, smooth part of the forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The pluralized or derived expression can occur in descriptions of dragging someone across the smooth parts of the forehead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A part of a horse's face near the meeting of the forehead and the nasal bone, or the area between the eyes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The terminology distinguishes the central area between the eyes from the sloping parts beside it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made smooth and even, especially an arrow or other prepared object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived passive participle can describe an object finished by smoothing or evening it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A creature or created thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: When substantivized, the passive participle has a plural referring to created beings or things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Forged or falsely attributed, especially an ode attributed to someone other than its author.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative passive-participial use concerning authorship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Generous in natural disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective describes a favorable character or innate disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Created with a nature suited to a role, such as dominion or companionship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The complement لِـ identifies the role or relationship for which the person is naturally fitted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very smooth or highly even.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is intensive in meaning and can describe an exceptionally smooth surface.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Old or worn clothing is covered by the Form IV wear-out branch.
The idiom is based on the represented old-and-worn sense.
Example-only pointer to the next entry.
Dug land is covered by the related excavated-hollow branch.
The comparative aptitude phrase is covered by the aptitude sense.
The general smoothed sense is covered by the represented derived-form entry.

cautions: The root's two major orientations—proportioning and smoothness—should not be treated as one direct meaning in every derived form.
خَلْق and خُلُق are distinct Quranic headwords: the former concerns creation, created beings, and outward form, while the latter concerns custom and inner moral character.

خَالِق may be a general active participle in an indefinite construction, whereas the definite divine epithet الخَالِق denotes the Creator; comparative and plural contexts can emphasize proportioning or forming.

Some classical interpretations of “the creation of God” move between bodily constitution, created order, and divine religion or ordinance; these are preserved as constructional nuances rather than separate unqualified senses.
